default_policy.review_rule: Only one validated TikTok URL and the documented Ark endpoint may be contacted.

scripts/download_tiktok.py.purpose: Resolve metadata and download media for one user-provided TikTok HTTPS URL.
scripts/download_tiktok.py.custom_url_policy: not supported; the input hostname must be tiktok.com or a subdomain
scripts/download_tiktok.py.auth: optional user-authorized browser cookies or cookie file

scripts/assetize_tiktok.py.purpose: Optionally upload the full video to Volcengine Ark for one-to-one semantic shot labels.
